messages.text:
I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sorry it landed in that state, let me work out what is going on.

Two things to start:

1. Which model is it (for example NerdQaxe++, Hammer DC06, Nexus S1)?
2. What exactly happens when you plug it in: nothing at all, screen on but no hashing, an error on the screen, a noise or smell?

If there is anything on the screen or an LED pattern, a photo or a short video of the power-up helps a lot.
